title: Screw Jam: Unbolt Everything
description: Layered acrylic plates pinned tight by colorful bolts — pop the right screws into matching boxes, watch whole slabs drop free, and never jam your tray.
controls: Tap exposed screws to sort them into matching boxes (3 per box). Keep buffer holes clear and use power-ups when jammed.

zh-CN.title: 进厂打螺丝：解压拆板
zh-CN.description: 今天也在赛博电子厂疯狂打工！一层层亚克力板死死叠在一起，挑准颜色把螺丝全拧进同色盒子，看着整块板子「咣当」掉下去，解压值直接拉满。
zh-CN.controls: 点击没被压住的螺丝就能拧下，凑齐 3 颗同色装满盒子；别把中间备用孔位塞爆，卡关就点道具救场！
